# Spice development-loop fixture

This is a minimal package-main Spice application copied into an isolated
workspace by `internal/devacceptance`. Its lifecycle bean binds loopback port
zero and atomically publishes the selected address, process ID, and random
process identity through a test-owned file. Its health response reports that
identity plus a body-owned revision. The fixture exists to prove the production `spice dev`
supervisor without importing toolchain internals or adding another watcher.

The test generates the application with the repository's vendored dependencies,
drives atomic valid and invalid source replacements, and verifies that all
handwritten and generated bytes return to their original hashes.
